features.description: bytes in a type annotation is TBytes, not a TypeVar. One primitive-name list in internal/ast used by the parser; tests over that list in types and pipeline; re-freeze stdlib interfaces the fix corrects.
acceptance_criteria: pure func f(b: bytes) -> bytes = b; g() = f(42) is rejected by ailang check
Every name in ast.BuiltinTypeNames maps to a TCon in types.astTypeToType
Regression test goes red with bytes removed from the list
make test, make verify-examples and make verify-stdlib pass; changed stdlib interfaces listed
features.notes: ast.BuiltinTypeNames/IsBuiltinTypeName is the one list; parser uses it. types.astTypeToType also mapped unit/char to TVar (found by the list-ranging test), fixed. Stdlib re-freeze corrects net.HttpResponse.bodyBytes, process.ProcessOutput.stdout/stderr, stream.SourceBytes, sem frame fields/functions (all were type var a). Mutation: removing bytes from the list turns TestBuiltinTypeAnnotation_IntPassedAsBytesRejected red; reverting the unit/char mapping turns TestAstTypeToType_BuiltinNamesAreConcrete red.

features.description: std/audio.ail with Codec = OggOpus(int), wavHeader, wavFromPcm, durationMs (requires/ensures) in pure AILANG
acceptance_criteria: ailang verify std/audio.ail reports durationMs VERIFIED
Golden mono 24 kHz header equals the doc's 44 bytes; stereo 48 kHz has blockAlign 4 and byteRate 192000
wavFromPcm length is len(pcm)+44 and slicing from 44 returns the PCM
features.notes: std/audio.ail wavHeader/wavFromPcm/durationMs; ailang verify: durationMs VERIFIED. tests/stdlib/audio_wav_test.ail 13/13 under make test-stdlib-ail (SUITES_EXPECTED 4->5); le16(1)->le16(3) mutation turns 2 golden tests red.

features.description: Vendored go-opus v1.1.0 under third_party/goopus (no Go bump), deterministic own Ogg container, pure builtin _audio_encode_ogg_opus, std/audio.encode
acceptance_criteria: Builds on Go 1.26.6 with CGO_ENABLED=0 and for GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm
Two encodes are byte-identical; golden SHA-256 of the 5 s fixture holds on arm64 and wasm
Round trip through oggopus decoder gives the exact input sample count
5 s fixture < 40 KB, 50 s < 400 KB at OggOpus(24000)
Rate 44100, 3 channels, odd length, bitrate 0 and 1000000 each return Err naming the field
DONE WHEN: ~50 s 24 kHz mono PCM -> < 1 MB .ogg from an AILANG program, identical across runs, afconvert decodes to the right duration
features.notes: go-opus v1.1.0 vendored to third_party/goopus (declares go 1.26; no lowering needed; import paths rewritten, no replace). Own Ogg writer with FNV-1a serial. Golden SHA-256 identical on darwin/arm64 and js/wasm. DONE WHEN: 50.96 s say render 2,446,018 PCM bytes -> 236,967 B .ogg in 0.19 s, two runs cmp-identical, afconvert decodes to exactly 2,446,018 bytes / 50.958708 s. Mutations: random serial -> determinism test red; no end trim -> round-trip test red.
